summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K containing its FY2026 Full Year Results Statement for the period ended 31 March 2026. The filing reports statutory operating profit of £5,431m, underlying EPS of 78.0p (up 8% at constant currency), record capital investment of £11.6bn, and a recommended final dividend of 32.14p. CEO Zo Yujnovich comments on a £70bn five-year investment plan to modernize energy networks. This is a routine earnings release; it does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. There are no deal terms.
